meanings.en: to be ill, to be sick
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be ill', paired with 'заболеть'.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Аркаша, губернатор хочет с нами встретиться!
examples.trans: Arkasha, the governor wants to meet with us!

выучить.gloss: to learn (by heart or thoroughly), to memorise

meanings.en: to learn thoroughly, to master, to memorise
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'учить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to learn (by heart or thoroughly), to memorise', paired with 'учить'.

examples.trans: I learned all the new words.

examples.text: А я всё выучила. Я хорошо учусь.
examples.trans: And I've learned everything. I do well at school.

meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'town, city' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
He is the chairman of the city court.
We walked in the city park.

examples.text: Председатель городского суда. Илья Олегович Берг.
examples.trans: The chairman of the city court. Ilya Olegovich Berg.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

examples.text: Ой, это Илона! Я громко поставлю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's Ilona! I'll put it on speaker.

meanings.note: expansion of business into new areas

examples.text: Диверсификация, диверсификация... Я устал это повторять!
examples.trans: Diversification, diversification... I am tired of repeating this!
What does this diversification actually mean at all?
Diversification of the municipal economy of Sineozersk!

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.en: to depend on, be contingent on (with от + genitive)
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'висеть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to depend on'.

examples.text: Но всё зависит только от вас.
examples.trans: But everything depends only on you.

examples.text: Соберись, экономика города зависит от тебя.
examples.trans: Pull yourself together, the city economy depends on you.
Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

examples.text: Вот теперь звучит как настоящий мэр!
examples.trans: Now that sounds like a real mayor!

examples.text: Это звучит очень странно и подозрительно.
examples.trans: That sounds very strange and suspicious.

examples.text: Разве это не звучит великолепно для гостей?
examples.trans: Does that not sound magnificent for the guests?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

examples.trans: Pasha, what does all this mean?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.
He is the mayor of the town.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: to a job or a doctor

examples.trans: I'll write out a referral right now.
Which direction should we walk in?

examples.text: Сейчас выпишу направление. Где я вас могла видеть?
examples.trans: I'll write out a referral right now. Where could I have seen you?

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to go over again', paired with 'повторять'.

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to review', paired with 'повторить'.

examples.text: Ещё раз повторяю, я решил вашу проблему.
examples.trans: I repeat once again, I solved your problem.

examples.text: Каждый день ты повторяешь одно и то же.
examples.trans: Every day you repeat the same thing.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Это развитие разных направлений в бизнесе.
examples.trans: This is the development of different directions in business.

examples.text: Это слово «развитие» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'development' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('different, various').

examples.text: Нет, это невозможно. Мы из разных управлений.
examples.trans: No, that's impossible. We're from different departments.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ложный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('complicated, difficult').

examples.trans: Danila, let's go. Look, there's nothing complicated.

собраться.gloss: to get ready, plan to, gather

meanings.en: to intend, plan, get ready to

examples.text: Ты что, уходить от меня собрался?
examples.trans: Are you planning to leave me or what?
Are you planning to drink alcohol?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'разу').

examples.trans: You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Ваня, ты должен чётко выучить термины.
examples.trans: Vanya, you must clearly learn the terms.

examples.text: Это слово «термин» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'term' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Повтори ещё раз громко и уверенно.
examples.trans: Repeat one more time loudly and confidently.

examples.text: Подойди и уверенно заговори с ней.
examples.trans: Go up and talk to her confidently.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.en: to get tired, to grow weary
meanings.note: past tense устал / устала often means 'am/is tired'

examples.trans: I am very tired of sitting.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Ты должен чётко ответить на вопросы.
examples.trans: You must answer the questions clearly.

examples.text: Ваня, ты должен чётко выучить термины.
examples.trans: Vanya, you must clearly learn the terms.

examples.text: Лёва, отвечай шефу быстро и чётко!
examples.trans: Lyova, answer the chef quickly and clearly!

examples.text: Соберись, экономика города зависит от тебя.
examples.trans: Pull yourself together, the city economy depends on you.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that
